components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Standard 44px primary action button with Civic Cobalt background, subtle elevation, and tactile press micro-interaction.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 12px; font-family: var(--font-font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #ffffff; background-color: #3b82f6; border: none; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.25); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); outline: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #2563eb; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.99); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Clean secondary button on white ground with Slate 200 border and subtle hover tint.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 12px; font-family: var(--font-font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #334155; background-color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); outline: none; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background-color: #f8fafc; border-color: #cbd5e1; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3); }

components.css: .ds-card { background-color: #ffffff; border-radius: 32px; border: 1px solid #f1f5f9; padding: 32px; box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04); font-family: var(--font-font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 8px 0; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: #0f172a; } .ds-card-desc { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; color: #64748b; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Icon Input Field
components.description: 44px input container with integrated SVG start icon, subtle slate border, and soft blue focus halo.
components.css: .ds-input-wrapper { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; font-family: var(--font-font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-input-icon { position: absolute; left: 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; pointer-events: none; color: #94a3b8; } .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 44px; padding: 0 14px 0 40px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; background-color: #ffffff; color: #0f172a; font-size: 14px; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #94a3b8; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #3b82f6; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.10); }

components.name: Custom Checkbox
components.description: Accessible custom 16px checkbox with 4px radius, crisp border, and animated checkmark.
components.css: .ds-checkbox-label { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; font-family: var(--font-font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 12px; color: #94a3b8; } .ds-checkbox-input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 0; height: 0; } .ds-checkbox-custom { width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; background-color: #ffffff; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-checkbox-input:checked + .ds-checkbox-custom { background-color: #2563eb; border-color: #2563eb; } .ds-checkbox-icon { color: #ffffff; display: block; } .ds-checkbox-input:focus-visible + .ds-checkbox-custom { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3); } .ds-checkbox-text { color: #94a3b8; } .ds-checkbox-label:hover .ds-checkbox-text { color: #475569; }

narrative.overview: The Village Management System (VMS) design language blends the authority and precision of official municipal administration with the fluid elegance of premier modern digital tools. Surfaces feel weightless and serene, floating atop an ultra-soft cool mist background (#F8FAFF) rather than stark clinical white. High-density administrative information is organized through clear hierarchical tiering and deliberate micro-typography.
keyCharacteristics: Luminous & Friendly Civic Demeanor: Replaces austere municipal grayscale with uplifting cobalt accents (#3B82F6) and cool, airy paper surfaces.
Sculpted Soft Geometry: Signature pillowy 32px card silhouettes paired with refined 12px inputs and buttons deliver an inviting, approachable posture.
Quiet Depth: Restrained, ultra-diffuse ambient elevations (0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)) replace heavy borders or distracting dark drop shadows.
High-Clarity Micro-Hierarchy: 12px-14px informational density paired with prominent status indicators ensures rapid scanning and zero operator fatigue.

rules.name: The One Civic Voice Rule
rules.body: The primary Civic Cobalt accent (#3B82F6) is reserved strictly for primary actions, active highlights, and definitive focal points. At least 85% of any screen canvas must remain neutral to guarantee cognitive calm.

rules.name: The Semantic Truth Rule
rules.body: Emerald, Amber, and Crimson may never be used decoratively. They exclusively signify administrative status (alive/completed, pending/warning, deceased/destructive).

rules.name: The Masked Integrity Rule
rules.body: Citizen ID numbers (13 digits) must be rendered in tabular monospace font (Geist Mono) with semantic formatting (X-XXXX-XXXXX-XX-X) to prevent misreading.

rules.name: The Diffuse Depth Rule
rules.body: Shadows must never exceed 5% opacity. Surfaces float via light dispersion, never hard dark drops.

dos: Do maintain the 44px minimum height (h-11) on all primary interactive inputs and buttons to ensure touch and click accessibility.
Do wrap standalone surfaces in the signature 32px corner radius (rounded-[32px]) with diffuse ambient shadow.
Do render Thai typography alongside Latin with harmonious baseline alignment, using font-sans with adequate line heights (1.5 for body).
Do format national identification numbers in monospace font with hyphens (X-XXXX-XXXXX-XX-X).
donts: Don't use stark dark drop shadows (e.g., shadow-2xl with black 25%+ opacity); keep elevation airy and diffuse.
Don't use sharp 0px or harsh 2px corners on interactive cards; preserve the friendly rounded geometry.
Don't use arbitrary bright accent colors outside the Civic Cobalt palette and established semantic triad (Emerald, Amber, Crimson).
Don't place dense administrative tables on pure white backgrounds without structural card grouping or canvas contrast.
